sloka: हीनं रतिगुणैः सर्वैरभिहन्तारमाहवे ।त्यजन्ति नृपतिं सैन्याः संविग्नास्तं नरेश्वरम् ।। ६.१२५.१० ।।
transliteration: hīnaṁ ratiguṇaiḥ sarvairabhihantāramāhave ।tyajanti nṛpatiṁ sainyāḥ saṁvignāstaṁ nareśvaram ।। 6.125.10 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana honoured the Vanaras with gems and valuables, after Rama had spoken like that.
